2178-3817-6495-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2178-3817-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5147-6972-7936.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2248-4270-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2248-4270-7857.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Doppelganger and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

4091-7488-7791.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Topiary Lecturer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat.

215-1355-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-4742.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1453-3967--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

5231-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
5231-7096--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from the creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

2908-4986-6797--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2908-4986-6797--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

2440-7282.easyPrerequisites: You control another nonlegendary artifact creature.
2440-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome twice by paying {10}, creating two token copies of another artifact creature you control with haste.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the creature tokens.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of another artifact creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
2440-7282.notes: The cost will vary depending on the artifact creature you choose and how many creatures you control that share a type with that creature. The above cost assumes you control no creatures that share a type with the chosen artifact creature. If you control more creatures, then start the combo at step 3 instead for maximum efficiency.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-628-7199.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Slumbering Walker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

725-1329-3652-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Ornithopter, adding {R}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Ornithopter, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

3025-5170-5686-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3649-5334-5904.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3649-5334-5904.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability twice due to Roaming Throne.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying either of Etrata's triggers.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

618-2921-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2239-5195-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Ardent Elementalist
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Ardent Elementalist
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1247-1376-5963.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1376-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Priest of Titania's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

413-549-1365-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-549-1365-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2919-5070-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-5070-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3719-5231.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3719-5231.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1017-1242-1656-3408.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
1017-1242-1656-3408.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Talas Researcher's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

90-1769-2201-3025.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3194-4243.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Venser, the Sojourner. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

364-1283-1987-2556.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

3664-4222-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Magus of the Candelabra.
3664-4222-4657.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
